$comment: SI-assisted: generated with Gemini, reviewed and edited by Elias, Pina, Celina & Esquivel — [PROJECT_NAME] | Grounded on NASA PSI BASS-II (PSI-25, DOI: 10.60555/4qc4-de67, CC0-1.0) and NASA/TM-20210011385 (PSI-10 strictly excluded).
title: MicrogravitySimulationContract
description: Unified 80/20 JSON contract for [PROJECT_NAME] connecting FastAPI, the Three.js Microgravity Simulator (Esquivel), and the 3-Column Telemetry Console (Rocha, Dantas & Celina) with explicit NASA PSI/NTRS scientific grounding.

scenario_id.description: Unique identifier for the simulation scenario or empirical NASA PSI test record.

grounding_status.description: Explicitly distinguishes direct NASA PSI empirical measurements (BASS-II / PSI-25) from bounded NTRS physical interpolations.

inputs.description: Environmental and material boundary conditions configured by the mission engineer.

material_id.description: Canonical material identifier mapped to NASA PSI experimental samples.

material_name.description: Human-readable spacecraft material name (e.g., PMMA Cast Acrylic, Nomex HT90-40, Cotton-Fiberglass Blend).

gravity_g.description: Ambient gravity level in Earth g-units (0.0g ISS microgravity, 0.16g Lunar surface, 0.38g Martian surface, 1.0g Earth baseline).

environment_label.description: Mission environment label displayed in the UI console (e.g., ISS Microgravity 0g, Lunar Base 0.16g, Martian Habitat 0.38g).

o2_pct.description: Cabin ambient oxygen volume concentration (% O2).

airflow_cm_s.description: Forced cabin ventilation velocity in centimeters per second (cm/s).

simulation_3d.description: The 4 core visual parameters consumed by Esquivel's WebGL/Three.js 3D Particle System.

flame_geometry.description: Particle emitter morphology: 'spherical' for quiescent 0g diffusion flame balls (gravity_g == 0.0 and airflow_cm_s < 1.0); 'elongated' for ventilated or partial-gravity plume stretching.

burn_rate_mm_s.description: Flame spread rate in millimeters per second (mm/s); drives 3D particle emission speed, turbulence frequency, and flame envelope radius, plus the UI speedometer.

flame_color_hex.description: Primary hex color for the 3D flame shader ('#3B82F6' for clean blue diffusion combustion in quiescent 0g; '#F97316' for radiative soot-heavy orange/amber under airflow or partial gravity).

oxygen_factor.description: Normalized opacity and particle volume multiplier (0.0 to 1.0). When 0.0 (o2_pct < oxygen_limit_pct), the 3D simulator fades out the flame over 600ms leaving brief dissipating smoke.

telemetry.description: Quantitative safety metrics rendered in Rocha, Dantas & Celina's 3-Column Aerospace Telemetry Console.

flammability_score.description: Composite flammability risk index (0-100): 0-35 Nominal/Safe, 36-70 Moderate Alert, 71-100 Critical.

risk_label.description: Categorical severity badge synchronized with flammability_score.

oxygen_limit_pct.description: Minimum Oxygen Concentration / Limiting Oxygen Index (MOC/LOI in % O2) required to sustain combustion under the specified flow and gravity.

co_ppm.description: Estimated carbon monoxide byproduct concentration in parts per million (ppm).

co2_pct.description: Estimated carbon dioxide byproduct volume fraction (% CO2).

safety_copilot.description: Actionable fire-safety decision support and scientific boundary disclosures.

diagnosis.description: Concise physical explanation of the flame regime (diffusion vs. advective radiative spread).

suppression_action.description: Validated spacecraft fire suppression protocol derived from NASA BASS-II, FLEX, and Saffire findings (e.g., cabin ventilation shutoff prior to extinguishant discharge).

terrestrial_spinoff.description: Application of the microgravity combustion insight to Earth-based fire safety or clean combustion.

scientific_limitations.description: Explicit note on boundary conditions, empirical scope, or interpolation assumptions to prevent scientific overclaiming.

nasa_citations.description: Auditable list of NASA PSI datasets (CC0-1.0) and NTRS technical reports backing the simulation output.

id.description: Official NASA NTRS citation ID or PSI dataset identifier (e.g., PSI-25 / DOI: 10.60555/4qc4-de67, NASA/TM-20210011385).

url.description: Direct public URL to the NASA PSI repository or NTRS report.

finding.description: Specific empirical finding or table reference supporting the calculated parameters.

suppression_estimate.description: Optional first-order engineering estimate for ISS Fine Water Mist Portable Fire Extinguisher (FWM PFE) sizing and gravity-bounded thermal cooling efficiency (0g-1g).

cooling_efficiency_pct.description: Gravity-bounded thermal cooling efficiency (%) interpolated via sqrt(g) between 0g vapor-barrier penalty (68%, UFSC/VSB-30 & NTRS-20030003652) and 1g terrestrial baseline (100%).

estimated_flame_power_kw.description: First-order estimated heat release rate (kW) scaled from BASS-II burn_rate_mm_s and material heat of combustion.

estimated_mist_volume_ml.description: Estimated fine water mist volume (mL) required to absorb the reaction heat at 2450 J/mL divided by gravity cooling efficiency.

tank_capacity_used_pct.description: Percentage of the 2720 mL ISS FWM PFE tank capacity (NTRS-20130011664).

estimated_discharge_seconds.description: Estimated open-cabin discharge duration (seconds) anchored to NASA FWM PFE 55 kW / 1.0 s qualification.

confined_rack_note.description: Operational disclosure noting that confined electronics racks require up to 60 s in 0g because mist cannot curve around obstacles without natural convection.
